apps.name: SwiftClean
apps.tagline: Clean, speed up and protect your PC — every Pro tool included.
apps.description: SwiftClean removes junk files, browser leftovers and old Windows updates, finds duplicates and huge files, speeds up startup and keeps your drivers and apps healthy.
features: Junk & privacy cleaner for all browsers
Disk Analyzer with treemap, duplicates and similar photos
Startup manager, boot time and System Monitor
Software updater, registry cleaner, disk & battery health

notes: New: Space Saver – smart suggestions to free space (old videos, installers, disk images, big downloads)
New: Similar Photos, Video Compressor (H.265, uses your GPU), Empty Folders & Broken Shortcuts
New: Disk Analyzer treemap, System Monitor, Disk & Battery Health, Boot time, Privacy Tweaks
New: Multi-PC Dashboard with remote clean, Sinhala language, Diagnostics & error reports

apps.name: SwiftZip
apps.tagline: Open and create ZIP, RAR, 7z and 40+ formats — all Pro features free.
apps.description: A fast, modern archiver powered by 7-Zip. Right-click to compress or extract, protect archives with passwords and AES-256, split big files and make self-extracting EXEs.
features: ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, GZ, ISO and many more

notes: All Pro features are now free for everyone: self-extracting archives, split volumes, convert, batch extract and password manager
Small fixes in the file list
